content.text: You’ve spent months perfecting your design assets—fonts, templates, presets—but when it’s time to sell, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-costing-you-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]] gate slams shut. Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in Kenya. Local processors charge 5% fees and still fail 30% of transactions. Your customers abandon carts because they can’t pay. This isn’t a market problem. It’s an infrastructure problem. COREMERCH solves it with sovereign commerce stacks. No platforms. No subscriptions. No middlemen. You deploy your own digital store, own the code, and collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-minimum-viable-stack|crypto]] payments directly. This post explains how the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-5|The Real]] works, why it’s built for creators like you, and how to deploy it today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. A complete digital commerce stack that gives you full ownership of your store, payments, and data. The core components are free to use: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are handled by NOWPayments, which verifies crypto transactions on-chain with a 0.5% fee. No buyer accounts required. No KYC. The system fires automatically when payment confirms. You own the entire stack after deployment. COREMERCH delivers the architecture, then steps away. No ongoing dependencies. No platform lock-in. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for creators who need to operate outside broken financial systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the stack operates: 1. Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Zero hosting fees. 2. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Free tier supports thousands of transactions. 3. Orders are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets. You own the data. 4. Files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Instant, secure downloads. 5. Payments are processed by NOWPayments. Customers pay in 300+ cryptocurrencies. The system converts the price to crypto at transaction time, verifies payment on-chain, and triggers file delivery. The entire process is automated. No manual intervention required. The architecture is modular—each component can be swapped or upgraded independently. This isn’t a fragile hack. It’s enterprise-grade infrastructure, optimized for digital creators in regions where traditional payment systems fail.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who sell fonts, templates, presets, and other design assets but cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or similar platforms. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or other regions where financial isolation is the norm, this stack is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent infrastructure. You don’t want a platform taking 30% of your revenue or shutting down your account without warning. You want to own your store, your payments, and your data. This stack gives you that ownership. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—a market where currency collapse and payment rejection are daily realities. If it works there, it works anywhere. This isn’t a tool for victims. It’s a tool for creators who chose better architecture.
Own your store, payments, and data—no platform dependencies.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose: 1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Free, fast, and globally distributed. 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Handles order processing and file delivery. 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets. Logs every transaction securely. 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Delivers your design assets instantly. 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments. Verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. These components integrate seamlessly. For example, when a customer pays via NOWPayments, a webhook triggers the backend logic, which logs the order and delivers the file. The system is designed for reliability, speed, and cost efficiency. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. This isn’t a collection of tools. It’s a unified stack, engineered to solve your specific problem.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Ready to deploy? Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant access to the source code. Alternatively, choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for pre-built deployments. Each option comes with 30-day support. Here’s how to proceed: 1. Choose your stack based on your needs. 2. Deploy the components using the provided blueprints or pre-built stacks. 3. Load your design assets into the system. 4. Configure NOWPayments for crypto pricing in USD. 5. Test end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. No ongoing fees. No platform dependencies. This is your store, your payments, your data. Start selling your design assets today—without Stripe, without PayPal, without compromise.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling design assets with crypto payments means deploying a sovereign commerce stack that handles hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. The system uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Customers pay in cryptocurrencies like USDT or BTC, and the system automatically verifies the payment on-chain, logs the order, and delivers the file. You own the entire infrastructure after deployment, with no platform dependencies or recurring fees. This solution is built for digital creators in regions where traditional payment systems are unavailable or unreliable.
Deploy in 48 hours with pre-built stacks or complete blueprints.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy this infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant access to the source code. It’s the fastest way to launch your sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for pre-built deployments, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for full blueprints and templates. 2. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Connect order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Upload your design assets to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 7. Test the entire system end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. 8. Launch your store and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints designed for non-developers. Pre-built stacks like the Sovereign Starter Stack are also available for instant deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT, BTC, ETH, and stablecoins on BSC, Solana, and TRON networks for low fees.
Do I need to pay recurring fees after deployment?
No. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
Can I sell multiple types of design assets?
Yes. The stack supports ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and more. Simply load your products into the system.
What happens if a payment fails?
The system automatically retries verification. If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and no file is delivered. You retain full control over the process.
